transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my right knee, mainly. It's been giving me more and more trouble and it's getting me down a bit.
Have you ever had a bad reaction or allergy to any medicine?
Yes, penicillin gives me a rash. Nothing else that I know of.
How much is your knee trouble getting in the way of your daily activities?
Quite a lot, really. I can't manage walking the dog round the park anymore, and I have to go down the stairs one step at a time holding the rail.
Could you tell me what medicines you take regularly, if any?
I take metformin, 1 gram twice a day, and aspirin 75 mg once a day. Then atorvastatin 40 mg at night, and ramipril 5 mg once a day.
Have you ever had any operations?
I had a stent put in a heart artery about 6 years ago. Nothing else that I can think of.
Besides how it affects your walking and stairs, have you noticed anything else going on with your right knee?
The knee sometimes swells up a bit by the evening, but there's no redness or fever, and it doesn't lock up on me.
Is there anything you've noticed that makes your knee feel better or worse?
It's worse going down the stairs, and after I've been walking for more than about 10 minutes. Resting and taking paracetamol help settle it.
When did you first notice the trouble with your right knee?
It only started getting bad last week.
Can you tell me what your right knee feels like when it's bothering you?
It's a deep, grinding sort of ache. It also feels stiff in the mornings, for about 20 minutes or so until it loosens up.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about the medicines you take?
No, that's everything I take as far as I know.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about your knee?

It's the inner side of the right knee that hurts, and it doesn't spread down the leg. On a bad day it's about a 7 out of 10, and I'd really like something stronger for the pain — and I've been wondering whether I might need a knee replacement.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
